name: Resend
description: Transactional and marketing email, domains, broadcasts, contacts, templates, and delivery data through Resend's REST API.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Sending access or Full access API key, select capabilities, and let agents read, send, batch, or use the full supported API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: RESEND_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Resend API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-owned Sending access or Full access key.

credentialRequirements.name: RESEND_KEY_PERMISSION
credentialRequirements.label: Key permission
credentialRequirements.helpText: SENDING or FULL, matching the permission chosen in Resend.

credentialRequirements.name: RESEND_DOMAIN
credentialRequirements.label: Verified sender domain
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact verified domain agents may send from.

capabilities.label: Sent emails
capabilities.description: Read bounded sent-email metadata with a Full access key.

capabilities.label: Domains
capabilities.description: Read bounded domain metadata with a Full access key.

capabilities.label: Send email
capabilities.description: Send through the configured verified domain.

capabilities.label: Batch send
capabilities.description: Send up to 100 messages through the configured domain.

capabilities.label: Full Resend API
capabilities.description: Use all endpoints allowed by the customer-owned key.

approvalRequired.label: Send email
approvalRequired.description: Sending email requires approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Send email batch
approvalRequired.description: Sending a batch requires approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Resend API
approvalRequired.description: All other API operations require approval in Safe mode.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; sends and all other API operations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The agent may use every selected Resend capability without Relay per-action approvals; ownership, selected capabilities, provider key authority, domain binding, secret isolation, idempotency, provider limits, and audit evidence still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Resend tools and proxies the API key server-side.
Railway mounts selected Resend tools and proxies the API key server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer creates a Sending access or Full access key in Resend and enters it with the matching permission and verified domain.

evidence.supports: Resend uses one fixed HTTPS API origin, Bearer API keys, a required User-Agent header, and provider-safe response codes.
Customer-created keys are Full access or Sending access; a Sending key can be restricted to one domain.
Single sends allow at most 50 recipients, attachments up to 40 MB after encoding, and an idempotency key up to 256 characters.
Batch sends allow up to 100 emails and do not support attachments or scheduled_at.
Resend exposes rate-limit and quota headers and defaults to five requests per second per team.
